# ROME-matched protocol validation

Only the original fixed-scale ROME algorithm and the concomitant extension
are compared. Four original predictor distributions, Gaussian response noise,
the original sparse coefficient vector and 100-point penalty paths are used.
This is a declared validation subset, not the completed 100-replication grid.
Native ROME stopping and joint KKT tolerances differ; the accompanying counts
must be checked before interpreting elapsed times. Partial paths are ineligible
for full-path speed comparisons.

{{< include outputs/rome-paper-validation/results.qmd >}}

![Actual returned coefficient errors, with failed joint returns marked and no imputed tails.](outputs/rome-paper-validation/returned-paths.pdf)

# Unconstrained R4 scaling

The Path-Alg-first study varies sample size at fixed p/n and feature count at
fixed n. Path0 removes the existing Gram correction to match the objective;
the stock solver remains an accuracy diagnostic. Every ranked return passes
a common coefficient/scale stationarity and objective-gap gate. Setup is
separate from prepared numerical solve time.
